name: Halloween's Whispered Fate
source:
In 'Halloween's Whispered Fate,' Halloween is more than just a holiday—it's a turning point that could change your life forever. On this fateful day, you'll face choices and encounters that have the power to rewrite your destiny. This Halloween changed everything. Now, it's up to you to shape the chapters of your unfolding story.

[From F95Zone]
